question.text: A series combination of resistor of resistance <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>100</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Ω</mi></math> inductor of inductance <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></math> and capacitor of capacitance <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>6</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>25</mn><mo> </mo><mi>μF</mi></math> is connected to an ac source. The quality factor of the circuit will be _____.

solution.text:
The formula to calculate the quality factor of an LCR circuit is given by

Q=1RLC   ...1

Substitute the values of the known parameters into equation (1) to calculate the required quality factor of the circuit.

Q=110016.25×10-6=1100×10002.5=4
